description: Returns ten Morse code practice questions with their answers: letter to code, code to letter, words, listening and mixed rounds. Listening questions carry the code to play. Includes a link to the SandiMorse practice page.

language.description: Language of the answer and of the page the link opens: id for Indonesian or en for English. Default id.

mode.description: Round type: letter-code, code-letter, words, listen or mixed (default).

round.description: Question set number from 1; a different number gives a different set of ten questions. Default 1.

name: morse_practice
title: Morse code practice
